_note: Ground truth is curated from the seeded ad-hoc search endpoints and the report/search-preview HTML views, cross-referenced with the Snyk Code SARIF emitted for the fixture and the runtime POCs in POC.md.
description: perfmon Go performance-monitor API with seeded attacker-reachable SQL injection in the product/attribute/jobs search endpoints and reflected XSS in the product report and search-preview HTML surfaces.

vulnerabilities.description: The product-picker type-ahead search endpoint at GET /products/search reads the `q` query parameter and passes it into a fmt.Sprintf-built SQL LIKE query that is executed with database/sql (Snyk: go/Sqli).
vulnerabilities.vulnerabilityImpact: An attacker can smuggle SQL through the LIKE pattern to bypass the product filter, enumerate rows from any table reachable by the postgres user, or trigger errors that leak schema information.

vulnerabilities.description: The attribute-picker search endpoint at GET /attributes/search reads the `q` query parameter and passes it into a fmt.Sprintf-built SQL LIKE query that is executed with database/sql (Snyk: go/Sqli).
vulnerabilities.vulnerabilityImpact: An attacker can smuggle SQL through the LIKE pattern to enumerate arbitrary attribute rows, join across tables, or elicit error messages that leak schema information.

vulnerabilities.description: The sortable recent-jobs listing at GET /jobs/list reads the `sort` query parameter and interpolates it as an ORDER BY expression through fmt.Sprintf, so the whole ORDER BY clause is attacker-controlled (Snyk: go/Sqli).
vulnerabilities.vulnerabilityImpact: An attacker can substitute a subquery or CASE expression into ORDER BY to perform boolean-blind exfiltration of arbitrary rows accessible to the postgres user, or trigger errors that reveal schema details.

vulnerabilities.description: The product status report page at GET /report reads the `product` and `note` query parameters, concatenates them into an HTML document body via a same-package renderer, and streams the result with a text/html Content-Type using w.Write (Snyk: go/XSS).
vulnerabilities.vulnerabilityImpact: An attacker who lures an authenticated operator to a crafted /report URL can execute arbitrary JavaScript in the operator's origin, hijacking any session-scoped credentials the perfmon UI carries.

vulnerabilities.description: The dashboard search-as-you-type widget at GET /search-preview reads the `q` query parameter, concatenates it into an HTML fragment via a same-package renderer, and writes the fragment to the response with a text/html Content-Type (Snyk: go/XSS).
vulnerabilities.vulnerabilityImpact: An attacker who lures an authenticated operator to a crafted /search-preview URL can execute arbitrary JavaScript in the operator's origin, hijacking any session-scoped credentials the perfmon UI carries.
